summary: Bug Fix Verified: /all-services page TDZ (Temporal Dead Zone) error is FIXED. The page now loads correctly without the generic error screen. All UI elements verified - header, search, stats banner (59 Services, 8 Categories), category expanders, and service items all render properly. The fix moved allItems/totalServices/filteredItems declarations above the localized copy object L to resolve the ReferenceError.
